    Ringside

    Keep the archive in the fans' hands.

    Wrestle Lore has no network behind it and no ads to answer to. Ringside patrons cover the research, the writing, and the servers, so every page stays free to read for the fans who come after you.

    • The archive

      Research, writing, and the servers that keep decades of history online and free to read.

    • The wrestlers

      Partnerships we are building to pay the people who lived it to tell their stories in their own words.

    • The room

      The Locker Room forum, pay-per-view watch-alongs, and meetups when the show comes to your town.

    Questions

    Fair questions, straight answers.

    Is it really free?
    Reading is always free with no account. Insider is free for founders who join now and stays free for them; after the founder window it is $9.99 a month. Ringside, the patron tier that funds the site, is $14.99 a month and optional.

    What can I do today, and what waits for launch?
    You can read the whole archive today. Rating, collections, your wrestling name, and the Locker Room open when accounts go live.

    Is my wrestling name actually reserved?
    Yes. Reserve it now and we hold it. When accounts open, it is yours.

    What is the Locker Room?
    It is the members' board: the debates, the five-star arguments, and the fan takes, all in one place.

    Is this official WWE?
    No. Wrestle Lore is a fan site, run by fans. It is not connected to WWE or any promotion.

    Claim your name. Be one of the first.
